head: 693386ee93cc
summary: Every tmux argv the daemon runs is `tmux -L legion-<project> …` (TmuxServer threaded through tmux.ts, worker-boot-watchdog.ts, processes.ts); pane secrets are 0600 files under <state_dir>/secrets (0700) named by role token, exported only as DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE / LEGION_BOOT_TOKEN_FILE / LEGION_CONTROLLER_SECRET_FILE; dispatch-token is written by index.ts at startup; consumers (envoy-client resolveDispatchConfig, pi-envoy requiredSecret/requiredControllerCapability, CLI resolveControllerSecret) resolve X_FILE ahead of X and never fall back; kill-pane `no server running` counts as pane-gone; smoke rig gains legion_tmux, private-socket down.sh, and checkpoint 13.

task1.message: feat(daemon): secrets.ts — 0700 dir / 0600 file primitives for pane secrets

task2.message: feat(daemon): every tmux command targets the private legion-<project> socket

task3.message: feat(daemon): pane secrets are 0600 files under <state_dir>/secrets, exported as *_FILE pointers

task4.message: feat(cli): controller commands read LEGION_CONTROLLER_SECRET_FILE ahead of the plain variable

task5.message: feat(envoy-client): DISPATCH_TOKEN_FILE resolves the bearer ahead of DISPATCH_TOKEN and dispatch.token

task6.message: feat(pi-envoy): boot token and controller secret resolve from *_FILE pointers, never falling back

task7.message: feat(smoke): private tmux socket everywhere; checkpoint 13 proves no pane or server carries a secret

task8.message: docs(daemon): file-pointer secret delivery, private tmux socket, live-box upgrade step

daemon.biome: bunx biome check src/ — clean (137 files)
daemon.test: bun test — 797 pass, 0 fail (802 tests, 54 files)
daemon.e2e: LEGION_E2E=1 bun test src/daemon/__tests__/real-shutdown-e2e.test.ts — 3 pass; `tmux -L legion-realshutdown list-sessions` → no server running

envoy-client.biome: bunx biome check src/ — clean (26 files)
envoy-client.build: bun run build — 12 entry points including secret-file.js (bun emits to dist/src/, pre-existing layout)

pi-envoy.biome: bunx biome lint extensions/ src/ — clean (19 files)
pi-envoy.test: bun test — 130 pass, 0 fail (run with LEGION_*/DISPATCH_*/ENVOY_* unset; legion.test.ts assumes a non-Legion shell, and a worker pane's own LEGION_TREE trips classifySession's both-markers guard)
pi-envoy.build: bun run build — envoy.js and legion.js bundled

smoke.checkpoints.test.sh: 10 PASS (includes the socket assertion and both checkpoint-13 cases)

deviationsFromPlan: Steady-state prune tracks the names ProcessManager itself wrote (paneSecretFiles) instead of listing <state_dir>/secrets on every persist(): the plan's per-save readdir added real fs I/O to every save, which made processes.test.ts fixtures that fake `sleep` (deadline timers fire instantly) race against the launch chain and flake; the boot-time prune (index.ts → ProcessManager.pruneSecretFiles) still lists the directory and reaps crash leftovers. Same observable contract: a file is removed by the persist that follows its locator being cleared.

Prune acceptance test drops the plan's `sleep: async () => {}` override: with a no-op sleep the controller registration deadline fires immediately and retires the just-spawned controller, deleting the very locator the test asserts on. The default fake WorkerRpcClient closes gracefully, so closeTree needs no fake timeout.

One pre-existing test (`does not drop a queued idle-resume assignment as stale…`) awaited a single `Bun.sleep(0)` after emitting idle; it now awaits the persist that records the dequeue via a saveState override — the promotion drain's persist is no longer a pure microtask chain.
checkpoints.test.sh scrubs LEGION_BOOT_TOKEN and LEGION_CONTROLLER_SECRET (not only DISPATCH_TOKEN) from the harness-owned sleep processes, so the harness passes from inside a Legion worker pane too.
LEGION_TMUX_LIVE tests in processes.test.ts use `-L session` (their project is `duplicate<ts>` etc., not `omp`).
observations: Load flakes seen once each across ~8 full daemon runs and never in isolation: `acquireInstanceLock > resolves exactly one winner…` (instance-lock.test.ts, unrelated), `WorkerBootWatchdog real-timer cleanup > never accumulates a listener…` (real timers), `admits only up to the configured global cap…` (5s test timeout on the file's first test under load). Final gate runs were green.
Plan §Observations: tmux.panePid targets a window for list-panes; checkpoint 13 uses display-message -p -t %N '#{pane_pid}' — unchanged, outside scope.

The daemon writes an empty `.omp/config.yml` into the issue workspace before each worker launch (ProcessManager.writeOmpConfig); it is untracked by every prior commit and was removed from the working copy before committing so it never lands in the branch.
testerNotes: Follow plan §Tester instructions: build the branch pi-envoy plugin, `up.sh` (mode none), checkpoints 1–3 (Dispatch auth through the file), 13 (`CHECKPOINT 13 OK`), `tmux list-sessions` vs `tmux -L legion-<slug> list-sessions`, `ls -la $SMOKE_DIR/daemon/secrets` (drwx------ / -rw-------), negative control via `tmux -L legion-<slug> set-environment -g LEGION_BOOT_TOKEN planted`, then `down.sh` → `STOPPED tmux session legion-<slug> on private socket …`. pi-envoy tests must run with LEGION_*/DISPATCH_*/ENVOY_* unset when invoked from a Legion pane.
